definitions.explanation: A student attending elementary school (grades 1-6, ages 6-12 in Japan).

examples.japanese: {小学生|しょうがくせい}の⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧が⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧います。
examples.english: I have two elementary school children.

examples.japanese: {小学生|しょうがくせい}の⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦サッカー→サッカー：04726_sakkaa⟧をしていた。
examples.english: When I was in elementary school, I played soccer every day.

examples.japanese: この⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧は{小学生|しょうがくせい}でも⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Even elementary school students can enjoy this movie.

examples.japanese: {小学生|しょうがくせい}⟦{向|む}け→向け：11011_muke⟧の⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧を⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for books aimed at elementary school students.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧は⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧から{小学生|しょうがくせい}になる。
examples.english: My son will become an elementary school student starting next year.

notes:
{小学生|しょうがくせい} combines {小学|しょうがく} (elementary school) + {生|せい} (student).

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
- {小学生|しょうがくせい} (elementary: 6 years, ages 6-12)
- ⟦{中学生|ちゅうがくせい}→中学生：10973_chuugakusei⟧ (junior high: 3 years, ages 12-15)
- ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧ (high school: 3 years, ages 15-18)
- ⟦{大学生|だいがくせい}→大学生：01653_daigakusei⟧ (university: 4 years, ages 18-22)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}の{時|とき}/{頃|ころ} (when I was in elementary school)
- {小学生|しょうがくせい}{向|む}け (aimed at elementary students)

USAGE:
- Often shortened to {小学生|しょうがくせい} in casual speech as {小学|しょうがく} or {小|しょう}
